chapters.label: Discover
chapters.head: A natural environment for your baby, topic by topic.

panels.label: At A Glance
panels.title: Your baby's mattress at a glance

panels.label: Made For Your Family
panels.title: Made for your baby, and for your child as they grow

blocks.t: **Baby Cot Size** is made for your baby's cot or cot bed. **Junior Size** is made for the bed your child moves to next. Both are made from the same natural materials: a **100% natural Dunlop latex core** and a **100% cotton cover**.
Every size has the same Medium firmness, so the support your baby feels in the cot is the support your child feels in the bed.
Cot and bed sizes differ between manufacturers. Measure the **inside** of the frame, length and width, and check the maximum mattress depth your cot or bed allows.

panels.label: Our Promise
panels.title: What we promise you

blocks.t: **A natural environment for your baby.** Your baby sleeps on a core of 100% natural latex, under a cover of 100% cotton. There are no other materials, and no glued layers.

**Care for your baby's sleep, and for yours.** Steady support, a natural response to every movement and air moving through the core: a good sleeping surface for your baby, and, we hope, more rest for you.
We would rather you know exactly what you are buying for your baby than be told more than we can stand behind.

chapters.label: Origin
chapters.head: Your baby's mattress begins with a tree.

panels.label: From Tree To Foam
panels.title: Where your baby's natural latex begins
text: Before it is a mattress, natural latex is the **milk of a rubber tree**, a plant that keeps growing after it is tapped. It is gathered, and **Dunlop Technology** turns it into foam.
In the film the milk flows, gathers and is poured into the shape that becomes the core of your baby's mattress.

panels.label: Plant-Based
panels.title: Your baby sleeps on a plant, not on petroleum

items.d: Natural latex comes from the rubber tree. Many mattress foams, such as memory foam and standard polyurethane foam, are made from refined petroleum.
The tree is tapped for its milk and keeps growing.
The core is moulded as a single piece of 100% natural latex, with no glued layers.
Latex foam is open-celled, so air can move through the mattress your baby sleeps on.

panels.label: Dunlop Technology
panels.title: One piece, made with Dunlop Technology

blocks.t: The core is made with **Dunlop Technology** as one moulded block, with rows of ventilation channels formed in it as it is moulded.
Because it is one piece, there are no glued layers to separate. Open the zip and the whole core is in view: nothing is hidden from you.

chapters.label: Healthy
chapters.head: A natural, healthy environment for your baby to sleep in.

panels.label: A Natural Environment
panels.title: A natural environment for your baby to sleep in

items.d: Your baby sleeps on Dunlop latex from the rubber tree, moulded as one piece.
A 100% natural latex core and a 100% cotton cover. No other materials, and no glued layers.
An open-cell structure with ventilation channels lets air move through your baby's mattress, not only across its top.
The 100% cotton cover unzips, comes off and washes at 40 °C, so your baby's sleeping surface is easy to keep fresh.

panels.label: A Clean Sleep
panels.title: A clean, hypoallergenic sleep environment

blocks.t: Your baby deserves a clean place to sleep. The mattress is made only from natural latex and cotton, with no other elements, and is tested for harmful substances.
OEKO-TEX® Standard 100
blocks.d: Tested for harmful substances, for baby use

blocks.t: If anyone in your household has a latex allergy, please seek medical advice before you buy.

panels.label: Air And Dryness
panels.title: Air, warmth and dryness for your baby

blocks.t: Babies and children sleep warm, and every night leaves some warmth and moisture behind. A core that lets air move through it, instead of holding it at the surface, helps keep your baby's sleeping surface fresher and drier.
This is why we made the ventilation channels a feature of the core itself, and not a surface treatment.
The room matters too. Keep your baby's room at a comfortable temperature, as the guidance for your cot advises.

panels.label: Even Support
panels.title: Stable support for your baby

blocks.t: Natural latex is dense and elastic. It carries your baby evenly across the surface and answers every movement at once, with no slow recovery.
The mattress is made in one firmness, **Medium**, in every size and depth, so the support is the same from the cot to the junior bed.

panels.label: The Whole Sleep Space
panels.title: The mattress is one part of a healthy sleep space

blocks.t: A healthy night for your baby also depends on the cot, the bedding, the temperature of the room and the way your baby is put down to sleep. The mattress is the part we make, and we make it from natural materials, with care.
Always follow current guidance from the **NHS** and **The Lullaby Trust**, together with the instructions supplied with your cot.

chapters.label: Comfort
chapters.head: Your baby's comfort: stable support and natural adaptation.

panels.label: Your Baby's Comfort
panels.title: The comfort your baby will feel

blocks.t: Natural latex keeps your baby **on the surface** of the mattress and still follows their shape. It is the balance between **stable support** and **natural adaptation** that gives your baby the comfort of latex.
Your baby feels lightness and softness on top, and steady support underneath: a natural material, used with engineering precision.
Your baby is held up, not wrapped. There is no hollow to sink into and no slow recovery, so the comfort comes from the support itself.

panels.label: Support And Adaptation
panels.title: Support and adaptation need each other

blocks.t: **Support comes from density.** Latex is dense, so it carries your baby's weight on the surface.
**Adaptation comes from elasticity.** Latex is elastic, so it follows your baby's shape and answers every movement.
Adaptation without support lets a child sink. Support without adaptation is hard and unyielding. Your baby needs both, well balanced, and latex gives them together.

panels.label: Support
panels.title: Stable support, from density

items.d: Latex is very dense, almost twice as dense as many foams used in mattresses. That density carries your baby without a hard surface.
Your baby rests on the mattress, not in a hollow that closes around them.
The weight is carried across the whole surface instead of pressing in one place.
A dense, elastic material keeps its shape under repeated use, night after night.

panels.label: Adaptation
panels.title: Instant, natural adaptation

items.d: There is no delay and no warming-up: the latex answers the moment your baby touches it. Memory foam is slow to respond.
The load is shared across the surface instead of concentrating in one spot.
Every small movement in your baby's sleep is absorbed and answered as it happens.
The surface resets at once, so your baby is never working out of a dip. This helps your baby sleep more comfortably.

panels.label: Always On Top
panels.title: Your baby stays on top of the mattress

blocks.t: Your baby does not sink into this mattress. Your baby stays **on the top**, on the mattress, always.
Because your baby lies on the mattress and not in it, there is nothing to hold your baby back: turning, rolling and stretching take little effort.

groups.h: From the cot to the bed

blocks.t: The **Baby Cot Size** is for the cot years. The **Junior Size** is for the bed that follows, in the same natural latex.

panels.label: Calm Nights
panels.title: A calmer night for your baby, and for you

blocks.t: Sleep matters so much for a baby, and a good sleeping environment helps it. A surface that supports your baby evenly, answers every movement and lets air move through is made to help your baby settle.
And when your baby is comfortable, you can rest more too.

chapters.label: Firmness
chapters.head: One firmness, chosen for your growing child.

panels.label: Medium
panels.title: Medium, chosen for your growing child

blocks.t: The Baby & Junior range is made in a single firmness, **Medium**, in every size and depth. There is nothing for you to select.

Babies and growing children need steady, even support as their bodies develop. Medium is chosen to give a balance between your baby's weight and the support underneath, so your child can grow and sleep comfortably.

panels.label: Support For A Growing Body
panels.title: Support that grows with your child

blocks.t: A young body is changing all the time. The support should not be too hard, and it should not let your child sink. Natural latex does both jobs at once: it carries your child on the surface and gives way gently where the body presses.
Because latex is dense and elastic, the support stays even as your child gets taller and heavier, from the first cot to the junior bed.
Medium is the firmness of the whole range. We have not made soft or firm versions of this mattress, because it is made for babies and growing children.

panels.label: Nothing To Choose
panels.title: Why you do not have to choose a firmness

blocks.t: For adults we recommend a firmness by body weight. That table is not used for babies and children: their weight changes so quickly that one balanced firmness serves them best.
So you only choose what your cot or bed needs, the **size** and the **depth**, and the firmness is already right for your baby.

chapters.label: Ventilation
chapters.head: Ventilation for your baby: breathing channels in the core.

panels.label: Airflow
panels.title: Air moving through your baby's mattress
text: The open-cell structure of natural latex, together with the **ventilation channels** formed in the core, lets air move through your baby's mattress.
These breathing channels are part of the core itself, moulded into the latex. They are not a coating or a surface treatment.

panels.label: Breathing Channels
panels.title: Built to breathe, for your baby

items.d: Natural latex foam is open-celled, so air can pass through the material itself.
Rows of channels are formed in the core as it is moulded.
The channels are part of the one-piece core, not added afterwards.
Air can move through the whole depth of the mattress, not only across its top.

panels.label: Why It Matters
panels.title: Why ventilation matters for your child

blocks.t: Ventilation matters for children as much as for adults. Temperature comfort matters to everyone, and a child who is too warm is not comfortable. A child who is too cold is not comfortable either.
Warmth and moisture are what microbes like. The more air that moves through your baby's mattress, the less warmth and moisture is held there, and the less welcoming it is to them.
This is why the channels matter to us, and why we explain them to you: they work quietly, all night, in every mattress.

panels.label: How It Works
panels.title: From the structure to a fresher surface for your baby
panels.close: The channels do not change the temperature of the room. They help warmth and moisture move through your baby's mattress instead of staying inside it.

chapters.label: Cover & Hygiene
chapters.head: Your baby's cover and the hygiene of your baby's mattress.

panels.label: 100% Cotton
panels.title: Your baby's cover: 100% cotton
text: The cover is **100% cotton**, a natural fibre, and it is the part of the mattress closest to your baby. It is quilted in wide transverse waves and closes with a zip along the side.
The cover and the latex core are made together as one mattress: the cover is not a separate choice, and there are no other materials inside.

panels.label: Comes Off, Washes Easily
panels.title: Your baby's cover comes off

blocks.t: A zip runs along the side, so the cover opens and comes off. The one-piece latex core inside can be seen whenever you like.
The cotton cover can be machine-washed at **40 °C**. Follow the care instructions supplied with your mattress.

panels.label: Cleaner Sleep
panels.title: Hygiene of your baby's mattress

items.d: Air moving through the open-cell core helps keep your baby's surface drier than a closed foam would.
Unzip the cover along the side and take it off whenever it needs washing.
The cotton cover can be machine-washed at 40 °C.
One moulded block: there are no glued layers to trap anything between them.

panels.label: Keeping It Fresh
panels.title: Easy to look after

blocks.t: Take the cover off, wash it at **40 °C**, and put it back. It is a simple routine that fits easily into everyday life with a baby.
Use a fitted sheet made for the exact mattress size, and follow the care instructions supplied with your mattress.
A dry, ventilated core and a cover you can wash are a good start for a clean sleeping space for your baby. The rest is everyday care.

chapters.label: Benefits
chapters.head: What your child gains from natural latex.

panels.label: A Healthy Place To Grow
panels.title: A healthy environment for your child to grow up in

items.d: Your child grows up sleeping on 100% natural Dunlop latex, from the rubber tree.
Open cells and ventilation channels let air move through the mattress, night after night.
Dense, elastic latex carries your child evenly, from the first cot to the junior bed.
A 100% cotton cover that comes off and washes at 40 °C keeps the surface fresh.

panels.label: Why Latex
panels.title: Why natural latex is different for your baby

items.d: Latex responds at once. It does not wrap around your baby or recover slowly.
Tapped from a renewable plant, and not made from petroleum.
A single moulded block with ventilation channels and no glued layers.
The milk of the rubber tree, turned into foam by Dunlop Technology.

panels.label: Made To Last
panels.title: A mattress for the years, not only the first months

blocks.t: Latex is dense and elastic, and a dense, elastic material keeps its shape and its response under repeated use.
Because the core is one piece, it does not rely on layers that can separate. It is made for the nights of a whole childhood.

panels.label: Made For Your Baby
panels.title: Your baby's mattress is made for you

blocks.t: Your baby's mattress is made for the size and depth you choose. Please allow up to **20 days** for it to be made and delivered.
It arrives exactly as you ordered it, in the size and depth your baby's cot or your child's bed needs.

panels.label: Special Packaging
panels.title: A special package for your baby's mattress

blocks.t: The mattress for your baby arrives in a special package made for it, so that it reaches you in good condition.
Remove all packaging, including any plastic wrapping, before use, and keep it away from children.

panels.label: A Baby Pillow
panels.title: A baby pillow with every mattress

blocks.t: Every Baby & Junior mattress comes with a **baby pillow** as a bonus. It is packed inside the package, together with your baby's mattress.
Please follow the instructions supplied with the pillow, and current safer-sleep guidance, for when and how to use it.

chapters.label: Baby & Junior
chapters.head: Two collections, one natural philosophy, designed for growing years.

panels.label: Two Collections
panels.title: One natural philosophy. Two collections.

cols.d: Compact sizes, made for the different constructions of baby cots and cot beds.
list: Medium firmness, 100% natural Dunlop latex, 100% cotton cover

cols.d: Larger sizes and deeper mattresses, made for the move to a bed of your child's own and for the years that follow.
list: Medium firmness, 100% natural Dunlop latex, 100% cotton cover

panels.label: Why 10, 12, 14 And 16
panels.title: Why there are four depths

blocks.t: Baby cots are built differently, so the Baby Cot collection has two depths, **10 cm** and **12 cm**. The choice depends on your cot's construction and on the maximum mattress depth its maker allows.
A child's own bed is a different job: it is used for longer. The Junior collection is made deeper, **14 cm** and **16 cm**, so there is more latex under your growing child over the years.
A deeper mattress is not automatically a better one. The right depth is the one that suits your cot or bed, so please check its construction and its maximum mattress depth before you choose.

panels.label: Which One Is Right?
panels.title: Baby Cot or Junior?

blocks.t: If you are buying for a cot or a cot bed, choose **Baby Cot**. If you are buying for a bed your child will sleep in on their own, choose **Junior**.

t: **Measure inside.** The inside length and width of the cot or bed frame.
**Check the depth.** The maximum mattress depth the cot or bed maker allows.
**Choose the collection** that matches the frame, then the size and the depth.

blocks.t: The two collections share one natural philosophy: a 100% natural latex core and a 100% cotton cover. They are not different levels of quality, but two solutions for two stages of growing up.

chapters.label: Care & Fit
chapters.head: Fit, care and safer sleep for your baby.

panels.label: Fit
panels.title: Find the right fit for your cot or bed

blocks.t: Cot and bed sizes differ between manufacturers. The right mattress is the one that matches the inside of your frame.

t: **Measure inside.** Length and width of the cot or bed frame, not the outside.
**Match the size.** It should fit snugly, with no gaps at the sides or ends.
**Check the depth.** Many cots state a maximum mattress depth: choose a depth within it.
**Follow your cot.** Use its instructions on mattress size and maximum depth.

panels.label: Before Use
panels.title: Before it goes in your baby's cot

t: **Unpacking.** Remove all packaging, including any plastic wrapping, before use, and keep it away from children.
**Bedding.** Use a fitted sheet made for the exact mattress size. Keep the sleeping surface flat and clear.
**Cover.** The cover comes off and can be washed at 40 °C. Follow the care instructions supplied with your mattress.

panels.label: Latex & Safer Sleep
panels.title: Latex and safer sleep

blocks.t: If anyone in your household has a latex allergy, please seek medical advice before you buy.
Always follow current guidance from the NHS and The Lullaby Trust, together with the instructions supplied with your cot.
